definitions.short: Eljashib , the name of six Israelites
definitions.full: H475. Elyashib אֶלְיָשִׁיב proper name, masculine ( God restores , compare Nes Eg 194 & Sabean תֿובאל DHM ZMG 1883, 16 ) a. a descendant of David 1Chr 3:24 . b. priest of David's time 1Chr 24:12 . c. high priest of Nehemiah's time Ezra 10:6 ; Neh 3:1 , 20 , 21 (twice in verse); 12:10 (twice in verse); 12:12 , 23 ; 13:4 , 7 , 28 . d. a singer Ezra 10:24 . e. one of the line of Zattu Ezra 10:27 . feminine one of the line of Bani 10:36 .
